title: Manual/offline daily and weekly Solana address-mining runner
objective: Implement a deterministic manual/offline runner that selects canonical daily and Monday weekly address-mining jobs and invokes the existing fixture-compatible growth loop. It must not install a cron job, timer, network client, or live trigger. Repeated invocation for the same UTC schedule slot must produce the same run identity for the durable report store.
forbidden_actions: Do not install or activate cron, timers, background workers, or scheduled triggers.
Do not call live Helius, RPC, market-provider, database, Redis, or HTTP APIs.
Do not connect to or deploy PostgreSQL or Redis.
Do not add dependencies, unpark SOL-E2E-001, or activate BSC.
Do not persist raw payloads, credentials, or secrets.
